label: An originating cause has an occurring existentially productive exercise
term: productive-exercise reading of an originating cause
definition: OriginHasProductiveExercise F Occurs bearer produces: for every CausesOrigin c x edge, there exists an exercise a with Occurs a, bearer a = c and produces a x. CausesOrigin retains its existing primitive CAUSE_4 meaning of causal responsibility for x coming to be. The parameter produces takes exactly the sense it has in DEF-NO-EXISTENTIAL-SELF-PRODUCTION (eee784e7): production of the being (existence) of the resultant individual x, the existence token that the mixed-priority interfaces treat as a product, not merely a change, transformed state or coming-to-be of x. The step from 'c is responsible for x coming to be' to 'an exercise of c produces x's being' is therefore part of this bridge's OPEN content; it is not supplied by CAUSE_4 or by the word 'produces'. The bridge is not a definition of every sort of cause, a self-cause prohibition, a necessary-being explanation or maintenance. An existing builder bringing about a house illustrates only the actual-exercise requirement (an actually operating builder, not a merely capable one); it is not an undisputed instance of produces in the shared sense, since a maker of that kind is commonly classified as a cause of the house's becoming rather than of its being (Aquinas, ST I q.104 a.1). Whether such a case counts as producing the being of the resultant individual is exactly the open coming-to-be-to-being step. A process maintaining a house that already exists does not thereby originate it.
note: Analyst bridge, attribution deferred. The untimed CausesOrigin field has no defined temporal or ontic priority law, so a new interpretation premise is required; its applicability to actual origination is OPEN. The source's ordinary-language 'other than itself' phrase in DEF-CAUSE-OF-ORIGIN is not used to prove the conclusion by definition. Aristotle Physics II.3 distinguishes the actual builder building from a merely potential builder: this gives conceptual warrant for an actual productive exercise under a POSITIVE efficient-origin reading, not a universal proof. Hall's dependence/production distinction makes omission-based generic causation a live broader reading; Gott-Li gives solved self-consistent CTC configurations and a distinct conditional baby-universe reidentification scenario (not a solved dynamical self-generation), with the part-to-whole existence transfer still unproved. Aquinas ST I q.45 a.3 warns that creative action need not be a new temporal accident distinct from its bearer. The four existential-priority conditions are separately OPEN, and consistency alone does not establish an actual productive process. Strength: the bridge is stated for every CausesOrigin edge and is retained as the faithful statement of the productive reading of CAUSE_4 (its warrant, the actual-exercise requirement, is general and does not single out self-edges). Since #1610 the no-self-origination argument consumes the weak self-edge sibling (DEF 62acf1f0), which this bridge strengthens; their certified difference is the clause for origin edges between distinct beings, which carries the ordinary-origination defeaters (builder case, Hall-style dependence and omission causes) that do not bear on the sibling. Research with primary-text navigation and exact revision tests: docs/notes/unique-feedback-explanation-311.md, Origin-to-exercise warrant reassessment (2026-11-12). The bridge does not say an exercise is produced by its own target.
